newsitem.title: USA: Claridge says in talks with Hilton.
newsitem.headline: Claridge says in talks with Hilton.

text.p: Claridge Hotel and Casino Corp said Friday it is involved in acquisition talks with Hilton Hotels Corp, which currently holds between 35 percent and 40 percent of its outstanding notes.
Claridge also said it will not make the interest payment due February 3 on its 11-3/4 percent first mortgage notes due 2002, which would constitute a default.
The company said it believes it is highly unlikely that it will make the payment within the 30-day period.
Claridge is in the process of formulating a prepackaged plan of reorganization. An acquisition by Hilton would be through a prepackaged bankruptcy plan, it said.
Under such a plan, Hilton would acquire all of the stock in Claridge in exchange for Hilton funding a cash distribution under the plan to the holders of its notes.
Hilton representatives are in discussions with Claridge's financial adviser, Dillon, Read & Co, Claridge said. It said there are no assurances that a deal will be made.
Claridge, a closely held corporation, operates the Claridge Casino Hotel in Atlantic City.
